images.caption: Figure 1:An overview of Skill-α\alpha. Left: during inference, Skill-α\alphareads evidence sequentially and applies a sequence of local edit actions to progressively generate the skill from the initial statez0z_{0}to the final skillzTz_{T}. Right: during training, the skill generator samples a group of candidate actions from the current skill state, constructs the corresponding edited skills, and evaluates them on the same evidence-related anchored query with a benchmark-specific verifier; the resulting rollback rewards are then used for the GRPO update.

Figure 2:Training dynamics and rollout action distribution under the main ablations. Left: training reward over RL steps for Skill-α\alphaand its RL ablations. Right: action distribution accumulated over rollout steps. “SFT only” is omitted because it has no RL rollout trajectory.
